title: Content Library Still — mother and child

location.series: Cox Brand Collection — Lindsay Little / Periscope

slide_intent: Choose expressions and proximity that let a viewer read affection before noticing the device.
strategic_value: A tablet used within an affectionate exchange can make Cox feel compatible with family closeness.
demonstration: A mother kisses a smiling child who holds a tablet in a bright kitchen, with soft colored light at the edges.
practical_value: Select moments where the relationship remains the focal point while technology stays part of the scene.

content_islands.name: Family interaction
content_islands.spec: Place the mother and child together in the lower center, with the tablet beneath their faces.

content_islands.name: Kitchen and light
content_islands.spec: Keep the bright kitchen softly out of focus and allow violet and pink highlights at the edges.
